load_pretrained_model: load a pretrained fairseq model ensemble and task from a model checkpoint path
translate_sentences: translate a list of sentences using a GeneratorHubInterface with beam search
generate_token_hypos: generate token hypotheses from tokenized sentences using a GeneratorHubInterface with configurable beam
encode_decode_bpe: encode and decode text using a BPEHubInterface for Byte-Pair Encoding
encode_decode_tokenizer: encode and decode text using a TokenizerHubInterface for tokenization
